title: Isolation
description: Isolation modes and the evidence that a mode was actually applied.

IsolationMode.description: managed is Job Object lifecycle containment only, not a sandbox. restricted adds a low-integrity restricted token. app_container adds an AppContainer profile with explicit file capabilities.

AppliedIsolation.description: Observed evidence from the created process and its job, not a copy of the requested policy.

jobObjectAttached.description: The process was assigned to a Job Object.

appContainerToken.description: The child token is an AppContainer token.

restrictedToken.description: The child token is a restricted token.

lowIntegrity.description: The child token runs at low integrity.

fileAccessRestricted.description: Path-level file access is enforced by AppContainer capabilities.

networkCapabilitiesVerified.description: The child token's capability SIDs matched the network policy.
